info.name: FuelGo API
info.description:
FuelGo REST API v1. Run 'POST /auth/login' first; the token is stored automatically.
Demo logins: ravi@fuelgo.in / User@123, suresh.fuel@fuelgo.in / Provider@123, admin@fuelgo.in / Admin@123.

request.description: Verify, reject or suspend a provider.
Block / unblock a user.
Peak hours, top zones and a 7-day forecast.
Hourly fuel demand forecast for a date, zone and fuel type.
Retrain all candidate models on the latest data and keep the best.
Log in and receive access + refresh tokens.
Current user profile.
Edit profile / change password.
Exchange a refresh token (Authorization: Bearer <refresh>) for a new access token.
Register a vehicle owner or a service provider.
Enumerations used by the UI (zones, fuel types, problem categories).
Aggregate, non-personal platform stats for the public landing page.
Download a provider document (owner or admin only).
Public (unguessable) URL for request photos so they can be shown in tags.
Create (or reuse) a pending payment for a completed request.
Complete a UPI/card payment. Returns 402 PAYMENT_FAILED when declined.
Go online / offline (optionally with current GPS position).
Upload a verification document (multipart: `file`, `doc_type`).
REST fallback for live location updates (Socket.IO event `provider:location`).
Decline a request; it is auto-reassigned to the next nearest provider.
Advance the lifecycle; set `final_price` when completing.
Book a service (pick a provider or auto-assign).
Service history of the current user with filters and pagination.
Price estimate: fuel price × litres + distance-based delivery fee.
Nearby verified, available providers ranked by distance, rating and ETA.
Attach a photo of the problem (multipart field `photo`).
Demo: drive the provider to the customer automatically.
Current provider position and ETA (polling fallback for Socket.IO).
